QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_27

question.text: A Cat III AIF's incentive fees payable MUST align interests of the Manager with the Fund. Which mechanism BEST achieves this?

answer.text: Paying incentive fees upfront at commitment
Combining Hurdle rate AND High-Water Mark in the fee computation

explanation.text: The Logic: A combined Hurdle + HWM framework ensures manager earns only on genuine alpha above thresholds and cumulative high performance. The Trap: Upfront fees misalign; 50% is excessive; no-incentive eliminates alpha alignment. Cross-Exam Context: Industry best practice worldwide. Distributor's Pro-Tip: In DD, always check both components are present in the PPM fee section.
